dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Looks like it's a letter from a child who wants to join the Lightkeepers...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Lately, more and more people have been looking to join us. That's all thanks to everyone’s hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Even the merchants in Nasha Town, who normally don't care about the "public interest," are starting to see why we go to battle.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Who knows? Maybe it won't be long before we become strong enough to rid Nod-Krai of the Wild Hunt threat. What an exciting thought.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: But you should come back when you're older...
